title: Fictional daily service workload
provenance: Original deterministic teaching fixture; no actual events, people, systems, or measurements.
purpose: Illustrate descriptive exploration and chart interpretation, not operational generalization.
deliberate_features: 24 distinct date/service observations plus one exact duplicate
One deliberately constructed network spike on 2027-01-07
statistical_unit: One service on one UTC calendar date. Requests are counts; p95_latency_ms is an already aggregated per-service daily 95th percentile.
limitations: Fictional values intentionally encode patterns; associations are constructed, not empirical findings.
Averaging daily service p95 values does not produce an overall request-level p95.
Not a held-out evaluation dataset or representative sample.
